# Shopiators Public API

> Shopiators provides a public API that migration platforms can use to integrate with Shopiators stores.

## API Reference

- [Shopiators API Sandbox](https://api.shopiators.com/sandbox/): Interactive Swagger/OpenAPI reference for the Shopiators Public API.
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://api.shopiators.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable specification of the Shopiators Public API.
- [API Documentation (LLM-friendly)](https://api.shopiators.com/llms-full.txt): A clean Markdown representation of the full API reference for AI agents.
- [Shopiators Developer Documentation](https://docs.shopiators.com/): Official developer documentation.

## API Capabilities

The Shopiators Public API provides programmatic access to the following resources:

- Authentication
- Products
- Product Variants
- Collections
- Attributes
- Attribute Sets

## Integration Use Cases

The API is intended for:

- Ecommerce integrations
- Ecommerce migration workflows
- Product/catalog import and export workflows
- Catalog synchronization
- Third-party integrations
- Custom ecommerce applications
- Technology and migration partners

- Shopiators: https://shopiators.com/
